2364-3263-4331.description:
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Drafna by paying {1}{U}, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Mana Vault by paying {1}.
Repeat.

3899-5254-7741.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
3899-5254-7741.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat.

628-4247-7215.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Gnarlbark Elm.
When Gnarlbark Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

586-864-2267-3125-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-2267-3125-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Tormod.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

1011-2728-2921-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2728-2921-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2728-2921-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Cast Fate Transfer by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 4.

5702-6753-7798.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5702-6753-7798.description:
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 3.

215-1322-5711.description:
Activate Fanatic of Rhonas by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Fanatic of Rhonas from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Fanatic of Rhonas by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

215-1129-1849.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1129-1849.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2457-4289-4365-5434.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-4762-4772-7267.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Doubling Season and Michelangelo.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

3259-4053-4068-7604.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You either control another nontoken creature with mana value 3 or less, or have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control at least one Mountain.
3259-4053-4068-7604.description:
Declare Excava and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Excava triggers, returning up to one creature with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to another creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4053-4068-7604.notes: If both creatures used have haste, you can ignore the haste enabler.

1806-2060-5686-5902-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-4068-5921-5970.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
3457-4068-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

338-2034-3490-6097.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-2034-3490-6097.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Light of Promise attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Light of Promise attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

877-2908-6986.description:
Cast Dream Stalker by paying {0}.
When Dream Stalker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

4346-5220-6900.description:
Activate Darkheart Sliver by sacrificing it.
When Darkheart Sliver dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Darkheart Sliver on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Darkheart Sliver ability, causing you to gain 3 life.
Cast Darkheart Sliver from the top of your library by paying 2 life.
Repeat.

413-2173-5220-6535.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
When Serrated Scorpion enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

1987-4045-4423-6650.easyPrerequisites:
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
You control three additional Islands.
1987-4045-4423-6650.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Ur-Golem's Eye by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Ur-Golem's Eye.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1495-3129-4613-6843.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Primal Vigor.
Activate Anti-Venom using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1661-2604-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

573-4826-5451-5702.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-4826-5451-5702.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters untapped due to Archelos, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Wayward Swordtooth.
Because of the additional Wayward Swordtooth token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

1168-1651-1863-5921-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1168-1651-1863-5921-6756.notablePrerequisites:
Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1168-1651-1863-5921-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

1409-5184-6348.notablePrerequisites: You control a Dragon and/or have a Dragon card in hand.
1409-5184-6348.description:
Activate Sarkhan by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Sarkhan enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Sarkhan trigger, either choosing a Dragon you control or revealing a Dragon card from your hand and creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Sarkhan.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

3443-4824-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two creature cards in your graveyard.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
3443-4824-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Deathbloom Ritualist's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Soliton's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

147-4615.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Quasiduplicate
147-4615.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Quasiduplicate, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Quasiduplicate, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

372-2417-3277.notablePrerequisites:
You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse exiled by Abdel Adrian.
Izzet Chronarch exiled by Abdel Adrian.
You have enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
372-2417-3277.description:
Cast Siren's Ruse by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Izzet Chronarch and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Izzet Chronarch trigger.
Resolve the Izzet Chronarch trigger, returning Siren's Ruse from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Siren's Ruse.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Izzet Chronarch and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

5078-5642-5645.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2103-5626-5913.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
2103-5626-5913.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
You have at least {E}{E}
2103-5626-5913.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Pinnacle Monk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Pinnacle Monk, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1495-3129-4120.easyPrerequisites: Triskelion has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1495-3129-4120.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
1495-3129-4120.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

3398-5398.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures that can attack this turn.
Tesak does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
3398-5398.description:
Declare Tesak, Hellkite Charger and at least five other creatures you control as attackers.
Tesak and Hellkite Charger trigger.
Resolve the Tesak trigger, adding at least seven {R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

266-1624-3625-3646.manaNeeded: {4}{G}{G}{W}{U}{U} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
266-1624-3625-3646.notablePrerequisites: Tree of Redemption does not have summoning sickness.
266-1624-3625-3646.description:
On the end step prior to your turn, cast Ride the Avalanche by paying {G}{U}, allowing you to cast the next spell this turn as though it has flash.
Cast Storvald either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{W}{U} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Storvald enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing Tree or Redemption's power and toughness to become 1 until end of turn.
Activate Tree of Redemption by tapping it, causing your life total to become 1.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Near-Death Experience triggers, causing you to win the game.

659-1288-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
659-1288-5231.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

2-2034-2557-5043.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Alela triggers, creating two 1/1 Faerie creature tokens.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two Faeries, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2097-4222-5309.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Black Market Tycoon.
Black Market Tycoon does not have summoning sickness.
2097-4222-5309.description:
Activate Black Market Tycoon by tapping it, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Black Market Tycoon.
Repeat.

253-3859-4591.description:
Activate Cavern Harpy by paying 1 life.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Resolve the last Cavern Harpy trigger, returning it to your hand.
The remaining Cavern Harpy triggers fizzle.
Activate Soul Conduit by paying {6} and tapping it, exchanging your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
